name: Crystal Tower
description: The Crystal Tower, one of the most mysterious places in Tanares, has stood tall since the Ancient Age. It is a massive tower with one hundred floors and a large tameranium crystal on its top. Constructed by the Kemets, the tower is a remarkable blend of engineering and magic, possessing unique characteristics that have never been replicated. It is a place for extensive research and study, where the Arcane Council members work, and they govern from the Mage Tower. Before Avelum departed for the Republic, he warned that some secrets within the tower were too dangerous to be utilized. He cast powerful spells to seal parts of the tower and its underground chambers. Many wizards are now working to dispel these protections and access its mysteries. The tower possesses many defense mechanisms and traps, and records indicate that its underground contains a dungeon full of extraplanar creatures summoned by the ancient wizards to protect the place.
